channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Boeing layoffs: Company to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce as production delays threaten recovery plans
item.description: Boeing plans to cut around 5% of its Commercial Airplanes workforce through attrition and layoffs as it struggles to ramp up jetliner production, delays its 737 output targets and pushes back its $10 billion free cash flow goal to 2029.

item.title: Donald Trump says FBI is investigating Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy as trouble mounts for Nvidia CEO
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the FBI is looking into allegations involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a Singapore-based businesswoman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia’s board has launched an inquiry into whether Huang was a target of foreign intelligence.

item.title: Yes Bank AT-1 bondholders still await clarity on their money nearly a month after SC verdict
item.description: Investors are still waiting for Yes Bank to restore their ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond investments nearly a month after the Supreme Court overturned the 2020 write-off.

item.title: BNPL makes a comeback as payment apps try to fix its broken economics
item.description: The latest proposition combines payments, shopping and credit: acquire customers through UPI, finance their purchases and use repayment behaviour to assess them for larger loans.

item.title: Pay by the mile! GMR proposes nearly doubling UDF at Bhogapuram airport, drawing IndiGo's ire
item.description: Airlines and experts warn that higher fees could make flying less affordable, dampen passenger demand and push short-haul travellers towards trains.

item.title: Leak, conflict and loss of arbitration: inside a Tata Power Mumbai FIR
item.description: Tata Power has accused an arbitrator and former employees of undisclosed ties and leaking confidential data in its dispute with Kleros Capital. The allegations follow a Singapore ruling awarding Kleros $490 million plus interest, and an order to seize shares in two Tata Power arms.

item.description: Jacob's journey from growing a few plants during the pandemic to running a business with thousands of plants highlights how a childhood interest has developed into an entrepreneurial venture with an expanding customer base.

item.description: Nvidia's board has launched an independent investigation into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Here's what the company's bylaws say about removing him as CEO and director.

item.description: Alice Huang reportedly pitched a multi-million-dollar data centre project using Nvidia GPU access and Alibaba ties. Report reveals details of her business dealings amid the Jensen Huang controversy.

item.description: Existing investors, including private equity firm PAG, are selling their stakes in Acme's oral solids formulations business in a transaction that is expected to value the business at about $250 million.

item.description: Dabur is pursuing growth through wider rural reach, premium products and stronger digital sales without sacrificing its mass-market portfolio.

item.description: Why has the EU sued IBM, Atos and Leonardo? A look at the delays, rising costs and technical problems behind Europe's troubled smart border system.

item.title: Jensen Huang controversy: Megaspeed denies report on illegal Nvidia chip transfers to China, hints at legal action
item.description: The controversy has also renewed attention on Nvidia's efforts to expand chip sales to China despite US export restrictions designed to limit Beijing's access to advanced semiconductor technology.

item.title: Godrej Housing Finance targets ₹10,000 crore affordable loan book by 2031
item.description: The lender is betting on demand in tier 2 and tier 3 cities, where employment generation, rising aspirations and a shortage of affordable homes in metros are creating opportunities for housing finance companies.

item.title: Who is Ramswaroop Munde? Surat businessman wins internet over ₹1 lakh Diwali bonus viral videos — Watch
item.description: Munde, a resident of Bikaner in Rajasthan who runs a clothing business in Surat, broke with the common tradition of handing out gifts or sweets. He, instead, presented them with bundles of fresh currency notes.

item.title: Hindustan Coca-Cola IPO filings reveal Thums Up is outperforming Coke across 10 key Indian states
item.description: Coca-Cola bottler Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed for an IPO, structured entirely as an offer for sale. The company serves around 1.7 million retail outlets and sells 41 beverages across three categories. Coca-Cola holds 60% of HCCH, with Jubilant Beverages owning the remaining 40%.

item.title: Microsoft buyouts: ‘Concerned workers’ write open letter to management, urge rethink of ‘speed-at-all-costs’ AI push
item.description: Current and former Microsoft employees are challenging the company’s fast-moving AI strategy, calling for greater worker input and an end to tying AI use to rewards or reprimands. The letter comes amid job uncertainty and a voluntary buyout offer for eligible employees in four countries.

item.title: From a simple China TV reporter to top biz leader in Singapore, how Alice Huang came so close to NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang
item.description: The New York Times reports that US intelligence agencies suspect Alice Huang had ties to China’s Ministry of State Security and sought information about Nvidia. Jensen Huang initially said his interactions with her were normal business dealings.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Jensen Huang’s wife? Meet Lori Huang - What is her net worth, education and how did the couple meet?
item.description: Jensen Huang’s admission of infidelity has put his wife, Lori, in the spotlight. Married since 1985, she has largely avoided public attention and focused on philanthropy. Reports suggest a divorce could involve a significant division of the couple’s wealth, though no separation has been announced.

item.title: Vedanta bets on captive bauxite amid pricing dispute with Odisha Mining Corp
item.description: The company received a long-pending consent to operate its Sijimali bauxite mine in Odisha in September and now plans to begin production this financial year itself, targeting 1 million tonnes of output. The production is expected to rise to 5-6 million tonnes in FY28.

item.title: Blackstone-backed Aadhar Housing Finance sees limited El Niño risk to loan book
item.description: Just 6% of the lender's AUM is in districts identified as highly vulnerable to El Niño, while stable collections and underwriting safeguards offer some cushion against weather-related income shocks.

item.title: Medusa bets on spirits to diversify beyond beer, ties up with Stranger & Sons maker
item.description: The beer maker has partnered with Third Eye Distillery to enter the spirits market and is targeting ₹210 crore in gross revenue in FY27

item.description: Available retail categories at The Maharaja Shop include electronics, luggage, travel accessories, home essentials, wellness products, watches, and jewellery

item.title: ‘I take full responsibility’: Full text of Jensen Huang’s letter to Nvidia employees admitting affair with Chinese spy
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to his family and colleagues after admitting infidelity, as the company’s board investigates reports of a possible foreign intelligence effort. Huang said he would cooperate, while the board affirmed its confidence in him.

item.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy; Donald Trump calls Jensen Huang ‘honorable’
item.description: Nvidia’s board is investigating reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort after he acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom US intelligence reportedly says was recruited to spy for China. Huang has apologized to the company and his family.

item.description: Nvidia Corp.’s board is launching an investigation into whether Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign espionage plot after he admitted to employees that he was unfaithful to his wife.
